source_name: CVM Dados Abertos — DFP/ITR listed-company financial statements
notes: OPEN financial statements for listed companies (companhias abertas). Per-year ZIP with BPA/BPP (balance sheet), DRE (income), DFC (cash flow), DMPL (equity), DRA/DVA, capital composition, audit opinion. Keyed on CNPJ_CIA (= the company's CNPJ) + CD_CVM. Currency BRL, scale MIL (thousands). Verified: dfp_cia_aberta_2025.zip (12.5 MB); real data incl. BCO BRASIL S.A. Joins to the RFB CNPJ registry by CNPJ. Listed companies only.

The legal incorporation registries are the state Juntas Comerciais (NIRE number), coordinated by DREI. Registration acts and certified extracts are per-document / fee-based per state; no single open bulk. The RFB CNPJ data already covers the core registry fields openly, so the Juntas are a per-document enrichment (officers/acts). Cataloged from public docs.
